journey.name: Lift: what a program works
journey.description: A built-in program's sheet before following it: a week of it as a balance of sets per muscle group, the groups it leaves out named under the bars, and about how long each of its days takes. Then a built-in followed, its first day done, made yours: a copy opened in the editor, a week longer, saved and followed on from day 2. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: Tap the "Train" tab, which opens on "Strength"
Tap "Follow a program", scroll to "Simple & Sinister" and tap it
Verify that the sheet shows "Simple & Sinister", its summary, and under it "Balance" with "Sets in a week"

Verify that the bars read "Chest", "Shoulders", "Back", "Arms", "Core", "Glutes and hamstrings" and "Quads and calves", "Glutes and hamstrings" and "Shoulders" at 25, the chest's empty, with "Worked most" and "Assisted" under them
Verify that "Nothing in a week for: Chest, Quads and calves" is shown under the bars, and "Day 1" follows with "about 25 min" beside it
Swipe the sheet away, scroll to "15-minute kettlebell plan" and verify that its row ends in "about 15 min"; tap it and verify that "Day 1" and "Day 2" each say "about 15 min"
Swipe the sheet away, scroll to "Goblet squat and row", tap it, then tap "Follow this program"
Verify that Strength shows "Day 1 of 8 · week 1" with "about 10 min" beside it; tap "Start day 1", log one set, tap "Finish" and then "Done"
Verify that Strength shows "Day 2 of 8 · week 1"; tap "Change program", scroll to "Goblet squat and row" and tap it
Verify that the sheet shows "Following" and, under "Days done and left", "Make it yours"; tap "Make it yours"
Verify that the editor shows "New program", the name "Goblet squat and row (yours)", "You're following it: your copy carries on from day 2." and the blocks "Goblet squat" and "Row" with "(10–15)"
Tap "+" beside "Weeks" so it reads 5, then tap "Save program"
Verify that Programs lists "Goblet squat and row (yours)" under "Your programs", checked as followed; go back
Verify that Strength shows "Day 2 of 10 · week 1"
